hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, moderate institutional advisory risk, weak composites, and mostly marginal conviction warrant a defensive overlay. BTC is the most resilient signal but remains only modestly constructive. ETH and SOL longs are fragile due to negative alpha, elevated beta/volatility, and adverse expected shortfall. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have weak or negative institutional/liquidity factors. ETC is especially fragile and should not receive constructive conviction: its zero price, volatility, liquidity, and expected-shortfall inputs indicate unusable or missing data.
